changes.title: Independent quickslot capacity
changes.text: Quickslot storage can expand independently while the mobile interface continues to show six controls.

changes.title: Invalid shortcut assignment
changes.text: An invalid shortcut position no longer clears an existing valid assignment before failing.

changes.title: Inventory restoration safety
changes.text: Invalid saved shortcut positions no longer prevent the associated inventory item from loading.

changes.title: Placeholder restoration
changes.text: Sparse extended placeholders restore through the existing save format, and malformed placement arrays no longer crash loading.

changes.title: Rollback history processing
changes.text: Overlapping rollback ranges are merged before classifying events, reducing repeated scans while preserving history.

changes.title: Shortcut and timeline regressions
changes.text: Added expanded-slot, save-reference and rollback-equivalence cases, with native six-control and extended save/load checks.

changes.title: Rendered healing evidence
changes.text: Android checks use an actual slider touch and wait for rendered dialog pixels before capturing healing screenshots.

changes.title: Build verification evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST100's successful tests and incomplete screenshot acceptance alongside this batch's reproductions.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I separated the six-button mobile layout from quickslot storage and protected item loading from invalid shortcut references. Rollback-heavy statistics also avoid repeated history scans.
